comments.author: Junchul
comments.body:
To summarize above information and replies, and please correct me if I'm mistaken anywhere in my understanding of how management skill works to rank up.

To rank up management:

1. Get management skill. You need to have East Latin America permit as it is only obtainable from Veracruz. You also need to have frugality lvl 1 and storage lvl 3 as skill prerequisites.

2. Buy a ship that can have a management ship skill such as a workshop then add or have a shipbuilder assist you in adding that workshop to it. See page on workshop for more info about this.

*Your not being at a level high enough to make use of the workshop doesn't matter. You can still add it to the ship, you just won't get the benefits of it until you rank up your management skill to lvl 7 which you do by the following..

3. Go to sea and produce goods/items from a recipe book. Each great success you achieve at sea while sailing will add to your management experience points total.

*Helpful tip from Emma: to rank it up faster ensure the recipe you are using to produce is 3 levels higher than your management level.

Example: You are management lvl 1: Produce Gunpowder, a casting lvl 4 recipe from the firearms techniques skill book or any other recipe with an equal or higher skill level to that. The higher the better it seems, same with ranking up any other production skill.

*Helpful tip from Lu Yue: Combine ranking up management with ranking up other production skills to make the most of your time.

Here I my finds, my contribution to this article:

1.- Rank 1 and 2 don't yield eny exp, ie: cooking or storage r1 or r2 recipes will give no experience even if the other requeriments are met (be at sea sailing [moving], having a ship with ANY skill).

2.- Any recipes equal or above r3 gives experience to manamagement but only great success will add points to rank up management.

3.- It is false that high rank recipes gives more management experience than low rank recipes.

I tested management with managemente r5, cooking r14 and storege r13; cooking recipes rank 1, 3, 5, 12; storage recipes 1, 7, 10, 11, 13.

wiki:
This skill can be added to any aide by unlocking it at the Aide Academy -- see Sagres for details

Skill proficiency is gained when producing trade goods with Great Success while sailing/moving at sea.

Additional notes:

1. Currently equipped ship MUST have at least 1 skill added to it; any skill will work, even if you cannot yet use the skill(s), more skills (max 6)= more Management proficiency
2. Rank 8 or higher trade good recipes are recommended; if the production rank is too low, no proficiency is gained
3. You must be sailing/moving at time of production to gain skill proficiency; sailing in a circle outside of a port at minimum speed is enough
4. Unlike Arms, the total ship level does not matter
